[[File:Royce Russell portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Royce Russell.]]
'''Royce Russell''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 15 FL from Clarksville, Tn. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He learned the game in February 1996, became a tournament director and Squadron Member that year, and hosted a Regional in Louisville, Kentucky.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
Sitting in a darkened theatre with my Dad
          in 1977, watching Luke take on the evil Empire almost single-handedly,
          seared an unforgettable saga called "Star Wars" into my mind forever
          ( I was 7). With "Use the Force, Luke!" ringing though my head the next
          day, my friend and I re-enacted every scene, just as we had seen it
          in the movie. Since I had blonde hair, I always had to play Luke!I still whine a bit now and then, but not until recently did I ever
          think I would get a chance to re-enact Star Wars with my friends again!
          Yet, I did get that chance in Febraury of '96, when I learned how to
          play a new Star Wars card game. Later that same year, after running
          many tournaments, and helping out at a few conventions, I became a tournament
          director then Squadron Member. I was asked to host a Regional in Louisville,
          Kentucky that year too! We had a great turnout, and many more people<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
